## Diagnostics in this beta

Squiggly {{VERSION}} is a beta, and on Windows and Linux it sends diagnostics to the developer so problems can be fixed before the stable release. It sends errors and logs, what the audio engine is doing, and which app and system versions it runs on. It also keeps a copy in its data folder, under `diagnostics`. It never sends passwords, tokens, usernames, or server addresses with their sign-in parameters.

To stop it, click **Beta · sends diagnostics** under the player, or open **Settings**, go to **Diagnostics**, and turn off **Send diagnostics to the developer**. While it's off, nothing is sent or written. The Android app doesn't send diagnostics, and stable releases never include them.
